subject: System Design
title: Cache Hit and Cache Miss
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Cache Hit and Cache Miss.

hook.text: A cache hit returns data instantly. A cache miss forces a slow trip to the database. Hits are gold.

buildup.text: Hit rate is the percentage of requests served from cache. A 95% hit rate means only 5% hit the database.

discovery.text: Even a 1% improvement in hit rate can dramatically reduce database load at scale.

twist.text: A cold cache has 0% hit rate. After a restart, all requests hit the database simultaneously — a cold start storm.

climax.text: Monitoring hit rate is the most important metric for any caching layer.

punchline.text: High hit rate means the cache is doing its job.

quiz.question: What is a cache cold start storm?
options: All requests hit the database after a cache restart
Too many items are stored in cache
